# How AI 4 EFX is Driving Speed, Security, and Customer Experience


September 10, 2026


Enabled by the new[Equifax Cloud](https://www.equifax.com/about-equifax/equifax-cloud/) ™, AI 4 EFX is how Equifax is pairing the expertise of its global workforce with new AI technology to automate routine processes and allow its talented team to shift their focus toward complex, creative, and collaborative challenges that drive Equifax forward.


#### AI 4 EFX in Action


AI 4 EFX is already showing momentum that’s benefiting key areas across the company. Recent highlights include:


-


Security: Through AI and automation, Equifax is auto-resolving nearly 50% of all Security Operations Center (SOC) tickets, accelerating security architecture reviews by more than 60%, and auto-generating draft code to remediate vulnerabilities.[These and other AI-driven improvements](https://www.equifax.com/newsroom/all-news/-/story/equifax-details-ai-powered-defense-and-guardrails-in-2025-security-annual-report/) allow the company to avoid the “security versus speed” tradeoff, with the security function acting as an express lane for rapid innovation.


-


Software Engineering: AI assists with generating millions of AI-assisted lines of code, real-time coding, automating data quality and unit tests, translating unstructured designs into clear requirements, and executing instant recovery steps during system issues.


-


Consumer and Customer Call Centers: The company is focused on improving its call centers with AI-enabled and AI-assisted call processes. Recent initiatives include the use of a virtual agent in the U.S. call center that allows sensitive tasks like consumer credit freezes to be handled through intuitive, secure conversations. The virtual agent integrates with the Equifax call center technology to leverage the skilled expertise of human agents when required. This process decreases wait times and speeds time to resolution — improving the consumer experience.


-


Corporate Support Teams: Equifax is deploying AI in Human Resources to help employees map out individualized career paths, in the Legal department to securely analyze contracts, and in Finance to reduce manual processing times.


#### The Pillars: Excellence, Effectiveness, Efficiency


Core to AI 4 EFX is E3, a three-year strategic Operations plan unique to Equifax. It is built on three pillars:[Excellence, Effectiveness, and Efficiency](https://www.youtube.com/watch?si=vyOAxmnVFCi2B31T&v=CvMkzRCOtMM&feature=youtu.be) .


-


Excellence: Equifax is providing continuous AI upskilling and new learning opportunities to employees.


-


Effectiveness: The company is focused on delivering innovative solutions and superior service that creates maximum value for customers and consumers.


-


Efficiency: Being AI-forward means leveraging AI to handle routine tasks, and empowering employees to focus on the most strategic and creative parts of their jobs.


#### Looking Ahead: Continued Benefits


The pace of AI deployment is rapidly accelerating across every corner of Equifax and the company is seeing big benefits. In addition, Equifax doubled the AI-driven cost reduction goal set earlier in the year from $75 million to $150 million from 2026 to 2028 — reflecting accelerating momentum in deploying AI to drive speed, accuracy, and productivity.


[Learn more about AI 4 EFX](https://www.equifax.com/about-equifax/ai-4-efx/) .
